worldcombat.skill.crosspoison.summary: Two venomous blades snap shut from either side and scissor an X at the aim point: a target covered by both blades takes the full hit and poisons at the higher chance, while a foe only grazed by one blade takes a discount and has a harder time taking poison. Pick a foe or just aim a direction at the crossing point; an empty scissor only rings air.
worldcombat.skill.crosspoison.descriptio: The closing blades deal about %1$s contact damage to the centered target, with a reach of %2$s blocks.
The crossing point spreads %1$s blocks half-wide; other enemies grazed by only one blade each take %2$sx the power.

Every enemy cut settles at most one poison: grazed by only one blade, it poisons at the %1$s graze chance; covered by both blades at the crossing point, it poisons at the %2$s seal chance for %3$s, losing health over time.
worldcombat.skill.crosspoison.corrode.on: Corrode form: graze poison x1.2, seal poison x1.3, poison duration x1.15; costs scissor power x0.9 and slower windup and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.crosspoison.corrode.of: Edge form: cuts harder and faster; costs a harder time pressing poison into the wound.
worldcombat.skill.crosspoison.timing: Range %1$s, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.crosspoison.growth.0: From level %1$s the scissor power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.crosspoison.growth.1: From level %1$s the scissor power is %2$s and the seal poison chance rises to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.crosspoison.use.0: A simultaneous pincer that finishes one target
worldcombat.skill.crosspoison.use.1: Clip anyone crowding in beside the crossing point
worldcombat.skill.crosspoison.use.2: Poison a centered target at the higher seal chance
worldcombat.skill.crosspoison.preference: On: graze poison x1.2, seal poison x1.3, poison duration x1.15, but scissor power x0.9 and slower windup and cooldown - for winning on poison. Off (Edge form): cuts harder and faster, but poison is harder to press in.
Beyond this distance it closes in first; the reach is short, so a large value often still cannot reach.
When on, a target not already poisoned ranks higher so this poison is not wasted; when off all targets rank alike.
When on, a target with another enemy on a blade line beside it ranks higher, so one pincer grazes two; when off it only judges the target itself.
